build_blip_text_model: build a BlipTextModel that encodes input text with self-attention and optional cross-attention layers
create_blip_text_lm_head_model: create a BlipTextLMHeadModel for next-token prediction and causal language modeling with cross-attention
test_blip_text_encoder: test the BlipTextEncoder that stacks BlipTextLayer modules for multi-layer text encoding
refactor_blip_text_self_attention: refactor the BlipTextSelfAttention class to support both self-attention and cross-attention modes with KV cache
